heading: Solid angle — also a scalar group
text:
#### Solid angle — also a scalar group [LUNI.4.2.1]

`solid_angle` is likewise a `unit scalar`, not a `unit dimension`
(steradian is dimensionless, sr = m²/m²) — consistent with `angle`. The
physical distinction `lumen ≠ candela` (luminous flux is not luminous
intensity) is preserved by the **named-distinction mechanism** — the
same device that keeps `Hz ≠ Bq` and `Gy ≠ Sv` — so `luminous_flux` is a
named-distinct dimension, **not** defined as `cd·sr`. Steradian carries
no exponent.

Standalone dimensionless units (no derived units, no interconversion) are also
declared as scalars with a single unit member — every dB-family variant
(generic, full-scale, carrier-relative, SPL, antenna gain) is one of these.
